text:
Aisha (Docs): FYI I opened PR #4321 for the release notes + model-catalog update.
Summary: deprecate `redwood-3b` and point users to `redwood-3b-quant` with migration guidance. Need 2 reviewers and timing for the Friday release. Docs preview: https://docs-preview.internal/4321 

Ben - Eng: @Aisha looking now. Quick flag: SDK snippets need model id + quant param. I can push a tiny fix.

Ben - Eng: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model="redwood-3b-quant", quantize=True, prompt="...")
```

Aisha (Docs): Thanks. Also added note under the changelog 'Model catalog' section. We should state deprecation window (30 days) and a short migration note for Dedicated customers about rolling restarts.

Eli (Release): 30 days works. Call out KV cache invalidation and recommend rolling restart of serving nodes after switch. Short snippet: 'restart serving nodes or rotate instances to refresh KV caches.'

Carmen (PM): For Dedicated customers let's include an autoscaler config example and a one-liner about rollback steps in case of regressions.

Ben - Eng: Added autoscaler snippet and I fixed a broken link I found: `/guides/quant` -> should be `/guides/quantization`. Pushed commit.

DevX Bot: Preview updated: https://docs-preview.internal/4321 (build #227, status: 1 failed link check). Failing link: `/guides/quantization` -> 404 (internal routing).

Aisha (Docs): Good catch. @Ben can you double-check the link target and CI? Also CI shows flake in examples/test_snippets.py — might be a transient, re-run.

Ben - Eng: Fixed the link target (typo in relative path) and the test. Ran CI locally, looks clean. Pushing new commit now.

DevX Bot: Build #228: all checks passed. Preview: https://docs-preview.internal/4321 

Carmen (PM): Reviewing product wording. Can we add a one-liner in the release notes about expected latency variance for quantized models? Just a short warning for integrators.

Aisha (Docs): Added: 'Minor latency variance expected for quantized variants; see Optimize guide for tuning recommendations.'

Todd (Eng-SRE): Good. Also request that the PR gets the `changelog/model-deprec` label so release tooling picks it up.

Ben - Eng: Label added. Requesting review from @Carmen now.

Carmen (PM): Reviewing now. :eyes:

Carmen (PM): Approved. :shipit:

Ben - Eng: Second reviewer here. Plan to merge after business-hours window at 18:00 PT to minimize traffic. Will merge when green.

Aisha (Docs): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short Dedicated migration doc task after merge.

Todd (Eng-SRE): Noted — will prepare a short ops checklist for rolling restarts.

Ben - Eng: Merging when checks are green. :+1:

Aisha (Docs): Appreciate it.
